description: Reverse geocoding: convert latitude/longitude coordinates into the nearest street address. Returns formatted address, country, city, street, house number, and postcode. Example: reverse_geocode({ lat: 48.8584, lon: 2.2945 })

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own Geoapify API key for higher limits; omit to use the shared Pipeworx key.

name: reverse_geocode
